## Required consequences from other roles

| Required role | Invariant consequence |
| --- | --- |
| Slice Builder | `INV-006` — One configured builder owns repository understanding, architectural… |
| Slice Builder | `INV-007` — Planning is read-only and produces an evidence-based bounded plan |
| Slice Builder | `INV-008` — The slice has an explicit changed-output boundary, preserves baseline and… |
| Slice Builder | `INV-011` — A confirmed semantic-path certificate identifies the actual trigger,… |
| Slice Builder | `INV-013` — Implementation uses the accepted boundary and semantic-path certificate |
| Slice Builder | `INV-016` — The builder identity remains stable through the normal planning,… |
| Independent Reviewer | `INV-012` — Evidence claimed as independent begins in a fresh context independent of… |

## Observation limits

| Target | Visible projection |
| --- | --- |
| `artifact.plan` (Evidence-based slice plan) | concise plan and certificate consequences, not raw exploration |
| `artifact.implementation_receipt` (Implementation receipt) | compact phase result, not diffs or test logs |
| `artifact.gate_receipt` (Deterministic gate receipt) | configured outcomes and binding identity, not raw gate output |
| `artifact.telemetry_ingress` (Authoritative telemetry ingress) | authoritative projection and provenance, not child reasoning |
| `artifact.planning_handoff` (Strategic planning handoff) | strategic consequences, not planner transcript |

## Mutation boundaries

| Target | Authorized boundary |
| --- | --- |
| `state.campaign_lifecycle` (Campaign and slice lifecycle) | configured state machine and accepted transitions |
| `state.durable_history` (Durable terminal receipt history) | exactly one validated terminal receipt per run and slice |

## Mediated transitions

| Transition | Mediated by |
| --- | --- |
| repository implementation | `role.builder` |
| private checkpoint mutation | `capability.checkpoint_lifecycle` |
| user-visible commit publication | `capability.completion_publication` |
| strategic recommendation | `capability.strategic_reconciliation` |

## Explicit non-authority

- inspecting repository implementation or diffs for domain judgment
- implementing campaign work
- replacing builder validation with supervisor inference
- creating user-visible commits without an explicit per-slice user decision
- silently amending objective, work source, approval, or immutable configuration
